roadmap_title: Mastery Roadmap: Cloud Engineer / DevOps Architect (6 Months)

phases_summary.focus: Syntax, core programming, computer science principles & version control
Essential domain libraries, relational databases, data pipelines & algorithms
Specialized frameworks, architecture design, cloud deployment & optimization
End-to-end capstone systems, production CI/CD, documentation & testing
Technical interviews, LeetCode problem solving, resume refinement & mock interviews

timeline.title: Core Foundations & Tooling
action_items: Master Linux command line navigation, shell scripting (Bash), and process management.
Deep dive into networking essentials: TCP/IP, DNS, Subnets, and HTTP/S protocols.
Configure automated Git branching strategies and SSH key-based repository access.
Practice core automation scripts for remote server health checks.
timeline.project_outcome: Automated Linux Server Provisioning & Health Monitor Script

timeline.title: Core Domain Systems & Data Pipelines
action_items: Master containerization fundamentals with Docker: Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and images.
Compose multi-service architectures using Docker Compose (web + Redis + PostgreSQL).
Understand container networking, persistent volume mounts, and security isolation.
Deploy local microservices test suites with Dockerized containers.
timeline.project_outcome: Multi-Container Microservices Deployment with Docker Compose & Nginx

timeline.title: Advanced Frameworks & Architecture
action_items: Master Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform: Providers, State files, and Modules.
Provision cloud infrastructure on AWS: EC2 instances, VPC, Subnets, Internet Gateways, and S3.
Implement AWS Identity & Access Management (IAM) least-privilege security policies.
Automate cloud resource provisioning and teardown using Terraform scripts.
timeline.project_outcome: Terraform-Automated AWS Resilient Multi-Tier Infrastructure Pipeline

timeline.title: Comprehensive Capstone Portfolio Project
action_items: Master Kubernetes: Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress Controllers, and ConfigMaps.
Build continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines with GitHub Actions.
Implement centralized monitoring and metrics dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana.
Deploy the full containerized stack onto a managed Kubernetes cluster.
timeline.project_outcome: Production Kubernetes Cluster with GitOps CI/CD & Prometheus Monitoring

timeline.title: Technical Interviews & Placement Preparation
action_items: Complete targeted LeetCode Top 75 / Blind 75 questions (Focus on Graphs, DP, Trees).
Practice mock technical interviews with peers or platforms like Pramp / Interviewing.io.
Format resume using standard single-page tech format highlighting measurable project impacts.
Draft clear answers to behavioral questions using the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) method.
timeline.project_outcome: Polished Industry Resume, Portfolio Website, and Interview Preparation Notes

timeline.title: Internship Outreach & Job Placement Drives
action_items: Apply to 20-30 curated internship and junior engineering openings across LinkedIn, Wellfound, and campus drives.
Engage in targeted professional outreach to hiring managers and tech alumni.
Complete company take-home coding assessments and system architecture design challenges.
Conduct continuous mock HR and managerial interviews to master salary and offer negotiation.
timeline.project_outcome: Active Placement Pipeline & Internship / Junior Role Offers
